details:
AstroHub is an intelligent planetary site-selection platform designed to identify and rank suitable locations for establishing permanent human settlements on the Moon and Mars. It collects and analyzes planetary data from NASA sources, considering factors such as water ice availability, solar energy potential, terrain elevation, surface conditions, temperature variations, landing safety and radiation exposure.

Using Python, NumPy, Pandas, React and Leaflet, the platform processes geographical and environmental information and applies a weighted multi-criteria scoring algorithm to evaluate and compare potential settlement locations. It provides interactive planetary maps, suitability scores and site recommendations, helping users understand the advantages and limitations of different locations. Its innovative What-If Settlement Simulator allows users to adjust mission priorities and observe changes in settlement rankings. By combining planetary data analysis, intelligent scoring and visualization, AstroHub aims to support safer, more efficient and sustainable space exploration, reduce uncertainty in settlement planning and contribute to humanity's future beyond Earth.
